summary: Updated implementation plan incorporating findings from global and Indian voice-to-document & WhatsApp bot platforms (Jugalbandi, Bhashini, DoNotPay, LegalZoom, Manglish/Malayalam voice apps, and WhatsApp Gulf CV bots), including Auto-Fit 1-Page & Chillaksharam Unicode Normalization, Malayalam/English Voice Read-Back (Audio Preview), Smart Pre-Print Mistake & Missing Info Checker, Dual PDF Engine (ATS Vector + High-Res Print PDF), and full synchronization between the React app and standalone index.html export.
